admin_audit_hint: Every access to the internal contour: who, when, which section, and with which filters.
admin_last_batch_hint: The internal contour refreshes at least once a day.
admin_reports_hint: Immutable report snapshots. Publishing puts the file on the public contour.
admin_roles_hint: Accounts and the roles and scopes granted to them.
admin_settings_hint: Thresholds, semester boundaries and derivation rules. A change reaches the API immediately.
admin_sources_hint: Ingest sources and refresh schedules; manual import runs.
aliases_hint: Maps the source system's labels onto the dashboard dictionaries.
app_error_body: Try reloading the page. If the error persists, contact the system administrator.
app_error_title: The page could not be loaded
audit_footer: {total} entries. Retention is at least {days} days; there is no deletion path.
batches_hint: Every run is journalled: time, source, row counts, validation errors.
chart_dynamics_title: Checks and average originality by month
chart_empty: No data for the selected filters
chart_heatmap_scale: Colour scale: from the lowest to the highest value in the column
chart_suppressed_note: {count} of {total} values are hidden: insufficient data
confirm_delete: Delete this entry? This cannot be undone.
confirm_revoke_role: Revoke this role from the account?
confirm_unpublish_report: Unpublish this report? It will no longer be available on the public dashboard.
dict_code_hint: Unique code of the dictionary entry.
dict_entries_hint: Adding an existing code replaces the entry.
error_out_of_scope: The selected unit is outside your area of visibility. Change the filter or contact an administrator.
error_role_denied: Your role does not grant access to this section. Contact the system administrator.
error_session_expired: The session has ended. Sign in again.
escalations_units_note: The per-unit breakdown is always k-screened, whatever the role.
ethics_cases_empty: The Ethics Council register is empty for this period.
export_error: The file could not be generated.
export_official_use: For official use only. The export is journalled.
export_public_hint: The file contains the figures for the selected period with the current filters applied.
filter_program_hint: Enter the study-programme code - picking from a list is not available yet.
footer_about_body: This dashboard publishes anonymized statistics on originality checks of written work at Toraighyrov University. Figures are aggregated - by university, faculty and work type; no data about individual authors or works is published.
footer_updated: The data is refreshed at least once a day.
form_invalid_json: Malformed JSON, or the structure does not match
initiator_rules_hint: Derive the initiator role from the reviewer's address.
internal_overview_hint: Metrics within your area of visibility.
k_threshold_note: Groups smaller than {k} checks are not published - the value is replaced by «insufficient data».
kpi_avg_originality_hint: Mean across every check in the period
kpi_coverage_hint: Share of submitted works that were checked
kpi_escalated_hint: Suspicious works whose flag has not been cleared
kpi_works_rechecked_hint: Works with more than one attempt
login_dev_unavailable: This deployment uses the portal's single sign-on.
login_dev_warning: Mints a session without SSO. Development and tests only; unavailable on a real deployment.
login_hint: The internal contour is behind the portal's single sign-on.
login_title: Sign in to the internal contour
report_generate_hint: The annual report runs 1 September – 31 August; a manual report takes any date range.
report_none: No reports have been generated yet.
reports_empty: No reports have been published yet.
request_access_body: You are signed in, but your account has no rights to the internal contour. Access is granted on a request from the head of your unit, agreed with the system administrator.
request_access_staff_note: The teaching-staff role covers the public contour. Unit-level detail needs a separate role.
request_access_step_admin: The system administrator grants the role and its scope - a faculty or a department.
request_access_step_head: The head of your unit submits an access request.
request_access_step_signin: Sign in again once the role is granted, and the section opens.
request_access_title: No access to the internal contour
roles_grant_hint: A dean needs a faculty code, a head of department a department code.
roles_scope_department_required: Required for a head of department
rule_pattern_hint: Substring matched against the normalized work title.
rule_regex_hint: Regular expression over the normalized reviewer address.
section_dynamics_hint: Number of checks and average originality by month.
section_error_title: This section could not be loaded
section_escalations_hint: Aggregated counters of cases referred to the Ethics Council, with no personal data.
section_faculties_hint: Aggregated figures per faculty and institute.
section_histogram_hint: How checks are distributed across the originality bands.
section_overview_hint: Headline figures for the selected period and the change against the same period a year earlier.
section_rechecks_hint: The share of works rechecked after revision, and how many of them improved.
section_role_restricted: This section is available to the ethics council and the compliance service. If you need it for your work, contact the system administrator.
section_usage_hint: Active reviewers per month and the average check duration.
section_work_types_hint: Checks and average originality broken down by type of written work.
section_yoy_hint: The figures compared by academic year (1 September - 31 August).
setting_exclude_deleted_hint: Rows marked deleted stay out of the aggregates.
setting_histogram_buckets_hint: Percentages, comma separated and ascending, e.g. 50, 70, 85, 95.
setting_histogram_buckets_invalid: Edges must ascend and stay between 0 and 100
setting_k_threshold_hint: Groups smaller than k are not published. The recommended value is 5.
setting_originality_threshold_hint: Works below the threshold count as needing attention. The default is 70.
setting_role_mappings_hint: An array of objects: group, role and, where needed, faculty_code or department_code.
setting_status_rules_hint: JSON: default, escalate_when and a list of status/when rules.
settings_saved_hint: The API response cache was cleared - the change is visible immediately.
source_base_url_hint: Base URL for an API source, watched directory for a CSV one.
source_run_started: The run has started - watch the import journal.
source_schedule_hint: Cron expression; empty means manual runs only.
staff_unit_email_hint: The address is neither stored nor logged: the server keeps only an irreversible hash and a mask.
staff_units_hint: Ties a reviewer to a faculty and department; the unit breakdown is built on it.
units_coverage_footnote: The breakdown by unit is available from the 2025/26 academic year.
units_margin_footnote: A faculty total includes departments whose own cells are suppressed, so the visible rows need not add up to it.
units_own_scope_only: No breakdown: your scope is a single unit, and its figures are above.
units_pending_mapping_footnote: The breakdown by unit becomes available once the mapping of reviewers to units has been loaded.
units_program_footnote: A breakdown by study programme is not available yet.
units_unassigned_footnote: «Unassigned» covers checks whose reviewing unit could not be resolved.
usage_avg_duration_hint: Entered by hand by the compliance office; the source export does not carry it.
work_type_rules_hint: Derive the work type from the document title.
work_types_single_bucket: No breakdown by work type is available: the source export carries no work-type field, and fewer than one per cent of checks can be classified from the document title. Everything else falls to «other».
